_comment: USD per MILLION tokens. From https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing (checked 2026-09-02, cross-verified against each model's own docs page since the current gpt-5.x-codex naming looked surprising at first glance). OpenAI's prompt caching is automatic and has no separate write charge (unlike Anthropic's explicit 5m/1h cache-write tiers) - cache_write_5m/cache_write_1h are set equal to input so cache_creation tokens price as plain uncached input, same convention pricing_grok.json uses for Grok. Only models with confirmed pricing are listed; an unlisted Codex model falls through to costForUsage's unpriced path (tokens still show, cost flagged unpriced) rather than guessing a rate.

_rate_shape.cache_write_5m: unused on Codex; set equal to input so cache_creation tokens price as uncached input
_rate_shape.cache_write_1h: unused on Codex; set equal to input so cache_creation tokens price as uncached input
